items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I dig Zoo -- these are all younger players, you know, like to me, you know, and I dig all of those guys.

ctx.x: And -- well, like, he came up since me, [Stanley] Turrentine you know, and let's see, who else? I used to like when he swung more and I dig Zoo -- these are all younger players, you know, like to me, you know, and I dig all of those guys. And Scott, I dig Scott. I just hope he takes care of himself better because, you see, when you work -- you know, there are a lot of musicians that they got certain pets,
maybe ten songs, that nobody can beat them playing.
